GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Jumped the 8th obstacle awkwardly. Rider explained mount was racing keenly and when the race leader continued to show a tendency to shift out, near the 1700m he elected to improve to the inside. He acknowledged he should have made a greater effort to restrain the gelding in order to regain cover.  Trainer reported the gelding, which was having its first jumps race start, would benefit from racing with cover in order to run out the race distance. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
